ISO Week Date Converter

Convert any date to its ISO week date (YYYY-Www-D) and back — find the Monday of any ISO week.

Date → ISO week

ISO week → date

📖 How to use

  1. To convert forward: pick any calendar date.
  2. To convert back: enter ISO year, week and day.
  3. Press the matching Convert button.
  4. The result appears instantly.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is ISO week 1 defined?

ISO 8601 defines week 1 as the week containing the first Thursday of the year (equivalently, the week with January 4th). Weeks start on Monday.

Do all years have 52 weeks?

Yes — most years have 52 ISO weeks, but years starting on Thursday (or leap years starting on Wednesday) have 53.

How does the reverse conversion work?

Enter the ISO year, week number and day (1=Monday … 7=Sunday) and the exact calendar date is computed.
